note: Small private RV campground around Leisure Lake on the south edge of Rock Falls, beside I-88; not the membership Leisure Lake Resort in Joliet. The row along the north shore sits on open grass about 12 m from the water; the east and west rows are behind a shore lane and a line of trees. Controlled access; bank fishing, kayaks and canoes on the lake. No check-ins after 7 pm Sunday to Thursday or after 11 pm Friday and Saturday. --Claude
summary: Operator's one-page site read: RV sites, full hookups with sewer at every site, showers/restrooms, controlled access, check-in cut-offs; no rates, season or booking statement. Google 4.1/57 (newest 5 months ago). Not a membership park (Good Sam type CAMPGROUND, gs false; the Joliet Resort is the membership one). Lakefront holds for the north-shore row (open grass ~12 m to a ~6.5 ha lake). Note cleaned: the unsourced $30 rate, the season and the hookup text removed.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): no posted rate (operator site silent; Google says 'Contact this property for rates and availability'). Price passes on the RV Life $$ tier stored in rating (price_tier 2); an 8-year-old Tripadvisor review mentions about $25 for full hookups (not usable). Good Sam: not a Good Sam Park (directory gs false). Gateway: not needed. Presence: live operator site with phone, and Google 4.1 / 57 with a phone.

MEMBERSHIP / SEASONAL-LOT TEST: not a membership park - the Good Sam directory types it CAMPGROUND (the Joliet 'Leisure Lake Resort' is the MEMBERSHIP_PARK), and nothing on the operator page mentions membership, lots or seasonal agreements. The operator offers 'a short getaway or a long-term outdoor experience'. Recent reviews are transient stays (a business trip 11 months ago, a solo traveller, an RV-repair stopover, a fishing stay 5 months ago). The nightly share is not published. Long-stay character is not shown, so test 2 does not apply; keep.

WATERFRONT: stored lakefront kept, for the north-shore row only. The lake is about 6.5 ha (a lake, not a pond). Along the north shore a gravel lane runs east-west and the sites sit on its lake side: RVs/pads at 41.75435,-89.65326 and 41.75434,-89.65269 with open grass and scattered single trees about 12 m to the waterline (~41.75423); a reviewer 3 years ago 'set up in a site right on the lake and caught some very nice bass right from our site'. Site numbers are not published (no site map). The east row (around 41.7536,-89.6510) and the west row sit behind a shore lane and a near-continuous treeline, 25-40 m from the water: lakeview at best. Bank height was not measurable from imagery; the lake looks like a borrow lake beside I-88 with a narrow light rim at the waterline. The cleaned note carries the caveat.

FACILITIES: two Google reviews disagree on laundry (5 months ago 'no laundry or bathhouse'; 11 months ago 'a small laundromat on site'); the operator page lists 'Shower and bathroom facilities'. showers written from the operator; laundry not written.
SEASON: stored opens 04-01 / closes 10-15 is derived from the old note; the operator's page states no season. Left as is (silence), but it has no current source.
